criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Several frames are strong at 432 px: slide 1's headlights throw onto the bars with true blacks and one bright edge; slide 2's relief counts 42 worn and 28 fresh stripes with casts; slide 5's crosswalks count 7, 7 plus a black saw cut, and 8; slide 9's slab lights its coast and the Harris and Galveston inlays. Slide 7 reads as abstract beige bands with a dark plate behind the footer; slide 3's pan is a fifth of the frame in mid-tone brown and its bars measure 0.83 against 0.79; slide 4's 400 markers alias into dotted noise; slide 6's kit person reads slightly plastic.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One material argument, road paint on Gulf Coast asphalt, through every frame; key left and casts right; terracotta held to the panel, the start bar and League City's counties; value holds dark; 1 to 6 to 7 a real camera move round one corner. Slide 7's beige mass and slide 3's navy band sit slightly outside; slide 9's slab is a different object class.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces (42, 70, $233,400, $899,600, 55, 400, 72, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., the counted roll calls); universals name their set. Held under 9: slide 8 says bagging starts 72 hours after certification (c33) and cites c46, Houston Public Media's 'down within 72 hours', without saying the accounts differ; the 55, 400, six officers and the mayor's quotes rest on the Tribune because the Flock portal sat behind a challenge; slide 6 cuts the ballot quote at 'cameras' with no ellipsis. No fabrication, no hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: A Texan learns what is on the ballot, who decided, the twist (nonbinding against removal already directed), the clock, the scale and what follows in Kyle and Laredo, with the deadline named. The action half gives Harris County's hours only though League City sits in Galveston County too (c25, c26); the deck never says what the cameras record (c34); the caption's closing question has no answer in the deck.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Clear timely cover; frame 2 pays at once; the turn 6 to 7 lands; the close points to the next cities. Slide 3 tells that 70 and 55 differ without why and is the most cuttable; slide 5's headline is cryptic until the dek.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register, every house rule kept, some snap ('The word is the ballot's.'). Much reads as an attribution ledger: 'the Tribune reported' twice on slide 4, a stacked attribution on slide 8, 'Two kinds of number' machine-made, 'Drawn to illustrate.' closing eight deks.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The visual treatment is fresh against the last four decks. The subject is not: carousel no. 39 on 2026-10-01 covered Flock plate readers and named League City's November 3rd vote, Kyle and Laredo, 30 days before; the angle is new (the October 13th resolution, nonbinding, the 72 hours). Within the window by a strict count, a lead not a hard fail.

one_sentence_fix: State on slide 9 and in the caption that League City lies in both Harris and Galveston counties, and give hours that apply to both, so a Galveston County resident is not left reading another county's vote centers.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: At 432 px the paint-height macro reads as abstract beige bands, half the lower frame in the grey middle, the nearest bar under the footer with a visible dark plate behind the cite and site line.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the eye to about 0.6 m and yaw toward the kerb so the warning panel and stop bar enter the left third; tighten the pool to the two nearest chamfers; stop the foreground bar short of the footer band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The gutter pan is a thin mid-tone slab across a fifth of the frame with an empty lower third; perspective makes the 55 bar 0.83 of the 70 bar instead of 0.79.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rebuild as a TXBENCH plan relief like slide 2, or a near overhead look-down, filling 40 to 50 percent of the height with both bars from one zero tick, the ratio checked in screen space.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: 400 markers alias into dotted noise at feed size and the six brass officer markers are a thin strip at the bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Bring the camera down to about 1.2 m and forward so the front rows show prism faces; set the six brass markers alone one marker width ahead of the block, two touching; let the rear rows fall dark.

notes_for_panel: No hard fail on a reader's pass. Leads: slide 8 cites c46 in support of c33 without disclosing the difference; carousel no. 39 on 2026-10-01 already named League City's vote and Laredo's referendum.
